required_repairs.text: This function describes how the extra error from limited observation decreases toward the diffusion-limited value.
required_repairs.reason: Total readout variance tends to the positive diffusion-limited value. Excess error above that value tends to zero. 'Extra error' combines these two meanings.
required_repairs.minimal_repair: Refer to readout variance decreasing toward the diffusion-limited value, or refer to excess above that limit decreasing toward zero.
